bib.title: MASS: Masked Sequence to Sequence Pre-training for Language Generation
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 36th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), PMLR 97

question: Can a BERT-style masked pre-training objective be designed for encoder-decoder models so that language generation tasks with little or no paired data benefit from pre-training?
hypothesis: Jointly pre-training encoder and decoder by reconstructing a masked consecutive fragment, with the decoder seeing only the fragment's earlier tokens, improves low/zero-resource generation over no pre-training and over BERT+LM or denoising auto-encoder pre-training.
contributions: We propose MASS, a masked sequence to sequence pre-training method for language generation
We apply MASS on a variety of language generation tasks including NMT, text summarization and conversational response generation, and achieve significant improvements
state-of-the art BLEU score for unsupervised NMT on two language pairs: English-French and English-German

method.summary: A Transformer encoder-decoder is pretrained on monolingual text: a random fragment of about 50% of the tokens is masked in the encoder input, and the decoder predicts that fragment, with decoder inputs for non-fragment positions replaced by [M]. One pretrained model is then fine-tuned on unsupervised/low-resource NMT, Gigaword summarisation and Cornell dialogue response generation.
method.task: masked sequence-to-sequence pre-training for language generation

datasets.name: WMT News Crawl monolingual (en, fr, de)
datasets.preprocessing: sentences over length 175 removed; joint 60,000 BPE units per language pair (Sennrich et al., 2016)

datasets.name: Romanian monolingual (News Crawl + WMT16)
datasets.source: News Crawl augmented with WMT16 data

datasets.name: WMT14 en-fr, WMT16 en-de, WMT16 en-ro bilingual
datasets.split: test newstest2014 (en-fr), newstest2016 (en-de, en-ro); best model chosen on dev set

datasets.name: Cornell Movie Dialog
datasets.size: 140K conversation pairs; 10K/20K random pairs as validation/test, rest train (text also says 110K pairs used)

other.language_embedding: added to each token for NMT, learned end to end
other.pretrain_per_task: one model per language pair for NMT; English-only models for summarisation and dialogue

other.note: best of MLM/CLM combinations per pair

training.objective: log-likelihood of masked fragment x^{u:v} given x^{\u:v} (Eq. 1); fragment length k about 50% of sentence tokens; encoder masked tokens: [M] 80%, random 10%, unchanged 10%
training.lr: 1e-4 (pretraining, NMT fine-tuning, low-resource NMT); dialogue reuses pretraining hyperparameters
training.batch_size: 3000 tokens per mini-batch (pretraining); 2000 tokens per GPU (unsupervised NMT fine-tuning)
training.steps: 20,000 steps (low-resource NMT fine-tuning); pretraining steps not stated

other.unsupervised_nmt_finetune: back-translation loss only, no denoising auto-encoder loss
other.decoder_padding: masked decoder positions removed but positional embeddings of unmasked tokens kept; ~50% decoder compute saved

inference.decoding: beam search, beam size 5 (summarisation); others not stated
inference.samples: single run per setting; no seeds stated

metrics.name: Perplexity
metrics.definition: PPL on Cornell test, following Vinyals & Le 2015

eval.protocol: Single reported numbers; no significance tests or seeds

evidence.quote: each mini-batch contains 3000 tokens for pre-training

limits: Pretraining steps, LR schedule, warmup, dropout and seeds are not stated.
Only single runs, no variance or significance tests.
Dialogue data size inconsistent: 140K pairs, 10K/20K held out, then called 110K pairs for training.
BERT+LM numbers in Table 3 come from XLM, not rerun; Table 2 XLM is best of several variants.
Small 6-layer models only; Table 4/5 DAE dialogue numbers mentioned in text but absent from Table 5.
Authors acknowledge only future work on theory and more tasks.

terms.definition: MAsked Sequence to Sequence pre-training: encoder takes a sentence with a masked fragment, decoder predicts that fragment

lineage.note: MLM is the k=1 special case of MASS
standard LM is the k=m special case
prior SOTA unsupervised NMT; codebase reused
